problemSection.title: Why hydroseeding projects fail
paragraphs: Soil function is an integrated set of biological, physical, and chemical processes that enable self-sustaining vegetation. When soil is compacted, stockpiled, or stripped of topsoil, these processes break down.
Hydroseed slurry delivers seed and mulch, but it does not rebuild soil biology or structure. Germination is poor. Vegetation struggles. Contractors face callbacks and unhappy clients.

solutionSection.title: How Terra Revive improves hydroseeding outcomes
solutionSection.subtitle: Terra Revive pellets suspend in hydroseed slurry and apply evenly across the site. At 2,000+ lbs per acre, the pellets deliver organic matter and minerals that rebuild soil biology and improve germination.

details.label: Mixing
details.value: Add pellets to the hydroseed tank after seed and mulch. Agitate for 2 to 3 minutes to ensure even suspension.

details.label: Application
details.value: Apply slurry at standard pressure and flow rates. Pellets distribute evenly with seed and mulch.

details.label: Compatibility

details.label: Best for
details.value: Slopes, uneven terrain, large acreages, and sites where broadcast equipment cannot access.
